name: Pleuropulmonary blastoma
description: Pleuropulmonary blastoma (PPB) is a rare pediatric tumor of the lung that arises during fetal lung development and is often part of an inherited cancer syndrome (Hill et al., 2009). PPBs contain both epithelial and mesenchymal cells. Early in tumorigenesis, cysts form in lung airspaces, and these cysts are lined with benign-appearing epithelium.
